title: BatVision Complementary Sight-Echo Recovery
dataset: The Audio-Visual BatVision Dataset for Research on Sight and Sound, BV1/BV2
compute_preference: A10G 24 GB target; local CPU salvage only after local PyTorch initialization did not complete
public_source_lookup_gate: waived explicitly by user; no passed lookup test claimed
raw_size_preference: under 1 GB preferred; under 3 GB target if needed; 5 GB outer bound
blocker: Three mandatory gates remain failed after bounded salvage: BatVision CC BY-SA 4.0 is non-sublicensable and ShareAlike while Shipd requires a sublicensable grant and no restrictions on its rights; BV2 provides only seven verified physical locations and its upstream temporal splits reuse all seven; semantic novelty is 4.5/10 versus the required 6/10. The bounded fused model also failed to beat the strongest single-modality shortcuts.
status_note: Rejected at Pilot gate before Build mode. A smaller BV2 subset cannot repair the license, independent-family, or novelty failures.

license_compatibility.source_terms: CC BY-SA 4.0 grants non-sublicensable rights, requires ShareAlike for adapted material, and forbids additional downstream restrictions.
license_compatibility.platform_terms: Shipd requires a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable license to incorporated pre-existing material and prohibits incorporation that restricts Shipd's rights.
license_compatibility.required_remedy: Separate express rights-holder permission compatible with Shipd's assignment and sublicensing terms.

mirror_metadata.license_evidence: Full CC BY-SA 4.0 legal terms in termsOfUse
mirror_metadata.archive_prefix_probe: The first 1-4 MB of every archive exposed BatvisionV1 tar members; compressed range access is not a selective import route.

bv2_inventory.split_finding: Every upstream train/validation/test partition occurs within every named location. Time-gap acquisition bursts are not authoritative route identities and were not counted as independent families.

native_sample_audit.selection: chronological median row from every seven-location by three-upstream-split cell
native_sample_audit.audio: stereo PCM32 WAV, 44.1 kHz, 19999-20000 frames, approximately 0.4535 seconds
native_sample_audit.depth: 720x1280 uint16 NPY; all 21 inspected arrays finite; millimetre units

audio_shortcut_baselines.corruption: three fixed gaps totaling approximately 32-38 percent of the right channel; left channel intact

bounded_multimodal_salvage.model: standardized dual-form ridge heads on 12x12 image/depth summaries and 192-point binaural signals
bounded_multimodal_salvage.conclusion: No fusion benefit was measured. The slice is too small to establish readiness, but it does not rescue the proposal.

local_neighbors: Laundry Resource-State Reconstruction From Sound and Vibration
semantic_novelty.conclusion: The proposal combines BatVision's canonical depth target with a standard masked audio reconstruction head; domain change and two-head packaging do not clear the novelty gate.

compute.platform_target: NVIDIA A10G 24 GB GPU and 64 GB RAM

unmeasured_gates: No author-style U-Net or strong fused neural baseline was run after redistribution, independence, and novelty gates failed.
No complete grader/null audit was built because Build mode was not authorized by a Proceed verdict.
No source ZIP or prepared data package was created because redistribution is incompatible and the full raw source exceeds 5 GB.
No browser upload, Shipd import, Mark as Ready, challenge configuration, or submission was performed.

unresolved_gates: Permanent under current source/platform terms: CC BY-SA 4.0 non-sublicensable ShareAlike rights conflict with Shipd's sublicensable pre-existing-material grant and no-restrictions clause.
Permanent for BV2 as published: only seven verified physical locations, with every upstream split represented inside each location.
Measured novelty is 4.5/10, below the required 6/10.
No capability-matched fused baseline pass; bounded fusion was worse than the strongest single-modality shortcuts.
Full BV2 exact raw footprint is 6.6468 GB, above the 5 GB outer bound.

notes: The task was renamed exactly to BatVision Complementary Sight-Echo Recovery before pilot work.
The public-source lookup gate was waived by the user and is not used as a rejection reason.
Bounded salvage repaired access uncertainty by discovering and verifying the official public-files WebDAV route.
All 3,120 BV2 native rows and all 9,360 referenced media paths were inventoried; 21 exact triplets were downloaded and inspected.
Rejected before Build mode; no full challenge scripts, forms, prepared data, clean source ZIP, or output folder were created.
No Shipd submission or browser-side mutation was performed.
